headline.caveat: All-stock acquisition of Jony Ive's AI-device startup io Products (reported $6.4-6.5B); ~$5B of new equity net of OpenAI's pre-existing ~23% stake.

realized_to_date.caveat: All-stock — no cash moved; io holders received OpenAI equity at close (2025, after a trademark-suit renaming detour).

nature_md: OpenAI acquired io Products, the AI hardware-device startup founded by Jony Ive and LoveFrom alumni, for ~$6.5B in OpenAI stock (announced May 21, 2025; closed later that year after an 'io'/'iyO' trademark suit forced marketing changes). OpenAI already held ~23%, so net new consideration was ~$5B. Ive and LoveFrom lead design across OpenAI; the io team (~55 engineers/designers, ex-Apple) builds OpenAI's consumer AI devices — a pre-revenue talent-and-roadmap purchase, not a revenue acquisition.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: OpenAI issued equity; io lands as goodwill/intangibles and R&D headcount — no revenue contribution, pure investment in a future device category, expensed forward through device development.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: io shareholders swapped into OpenAI paper (then marked ~$300B, later $852B post-money) — the appreciation of acquirer stock, not the business, delivered the return.
